t: Redirecting rain rather than stopping it
a: اللَّهُمَّ عَلَى رُءُوسِ الْجِبَالِ وَالآكَامِ وَبُطُونِ الأَوْدِيَةِ وَمَنَابِتِ الشَّجَرِ
p: Allāhumma ʿalā ru'ūsi-l-jibāli wa-l-ākāmi wa buṭūni-l-awdiyati wa manābiti-sh-shajar.
m: O Allah, upon the tops of the mountains, the hills, the beds of the valleys and where the trees grow.
